verdicts.evidence: 450 runs on small synthetic problems (q∈{0.5,2,5}, a few variables) all converged with residuals ~1e-16 and blockwise optimality error ~5e-10; Mutation A shows removing Assumption 2.6 breaks feasibility. Real numbers address the claim but only on a clearly reduced setup.

Sweeping ‖C‖ on a toy problem (q=2, 48 initializations × 3 ρ) shows linear contraction factors ~0.06 for small ‖C‖ (0–1) degrading to ≥0.998 at ‖C‖=25–50, tracking eq. 4's mechanism. Reduced synthetic setup, not a full reproduction.

Box-constrained toy problem with active constraints at the limit (non-smooth) shows geometric gap decay (factor ≤0.088) across 4 cells × 12 seeds; 19,200 local-min probes found no better point. Mutation A confirms eq. 4 still needed. Small synthetic instance only.

Sympy derivation confirms all quadratic coefficients carry Δt³ (p=3.0000 fit); simulation on a small planar instance (T=6, N=2, m=2kg) shows contraction ~0.71 across Δt∈{0.002…0.1}; mutation removing Δt³ scaling breaks convergence. Reduced locomotion proxy, not full-scale.

The q≥10 transition was tested (10 q-values × 6 hyperparameter settings × 6 seeds) but no sublinear regime or transition at q=10 was found, and the paper does not report μ_x, μ_z, ρ to match Figure 2; the baseline comparison (PADMM, IPDS-ADMM, IADMM) was not run at all due to missing problem instances and hyperparameters.

No experiments were run: real robot experiments require unavailable hardware with no released code/models/logs, and the 2D simulation curves of Figure 5 cannot be matched because T, contact schedule, target CoM, initial state, and ρ are not reported.

overall: The logbook provides careful numerical support for the four theoretical claims (Theorems 3.1–3.3 and Corollary 4.2) on small synthetic problems, including mutation tests that confirm the mechanisms are load-bearing, but all are on reduced toy setups rather than full-scale problems. The two empirical claims (baseline comparisons and robot experiments) are not reproduced due to missing experimental details and unavailable hardware.
